extraction.Name: John H. Clifford
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent in fee, but took it on the advice of the Farmer and Superintendent, who told him that if he did not take it and pay the taxes that the land would be sold to pay them
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: mortgaged the land to Peter Deuhamel of Rapid City, So. Dak. for $1800.00 to pay the taxes, that he could not pay the taxes or interest on the loan so Deuhamel foreclosed the mortgage and took the land
extraction.Buyer: Peter Deuhamel of Rapid City, So. Dak. — mortgaged for $1800.00, subsequently foreclosed
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: could not pay the taxes so he mortgaged the land to Peter Deuhamel of Rapid City, So. Dak. for $1800.00 to pay the taxes, that he could not pay the taxes or interest on the loan so Deuhamel foreclosed the mortgage and took the land
extraction.Occupation/Income: farms what he can on the allotment of his wife
extraction.NOTES: Health is poor, suffering with gall stones; has a wife and six minor children depending on him for support; has no land, two cows and 20 head of horses, all valued at about $200.00; received no aid from the State, Government or County since his patent in fee was issued; after foreclosure was arrested and told that if he didn't get off the land they would put him in the Pen for seven years, so he moved off; document sworn November 30, 1928
